content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "product": ["Tea", "Coffee", "Tea", "Juice"],
    "category": ["Drink", "Drink", "Drink", "Fruit"],
    "units": [2, 1, 3, 4],
    "price": [12.0, 45.0, 12.0, 25.0],
    "date": ["2026-01-01", "2026-01-02", "2026-01-03", "2026-01-04"],
    "customer": ["Mira", "Dev", "Mira", "Ari"],
})

print(df.head(2)[["product", "units"]].to_string(index=False))
content_blocks.expected_output: Displays the first two product/unit rows: Tea 2 and Coffee 1.
